Featured project

Nightkeepers

Survive the night in a haunted house. Restore the power, search the rooms, hide when the killer comes looking. Built in Godot 4.6 over about five months, with versioned releases and a source repository on a self-hosted Gitea.

In the game

Menus and interface

Every screen is built in GDScript with Godot's Control nodes: the main menu, co-op lobby and a settings screen with audio, graphics and controls tabs.

What I built

Killer AI

Patrols, stalks, bursts into chase, toys with players and sets ambushes. Runs on navigation meshes and trigger volumes, with a zombie variant carrying an axe.

Power failure loop

The killer smashes the breaker box. Players refuel a gas generator and start it step by step to bring the lights back.

Hiding and stealth

Crouch, peek through gaps, hide in closets or under beds, with camera views that match each hiding spot.

Interaction systems

Searchable furniture, doors, lockable sash windows with shutters, light switches, a notepad, a working clock and a TV.

Co-op multiplayer

Lobby with room codes, spectator mode, hosting from your own PC through an online relay, and an optional dedicated server.

First-person body

Visible arms, flashlight and tool grips, reach gestures and rig retargeting so held items sit correctly in hand.

Performance

I profiled the game, batched terrain and grass, and removed outdoor pop-in. I also added an Auto graphics setting that picks a preset for the machine.

Before17 FPS
After~54 FPS

Second portfolio

FiveM scripts and interfaces

I write FiveM server scripts in Lua with custom in-game interfaces in HTML, CSS and JavaScript, for ESX and QBCore servers. The full set, with screenshots, is on my FiveM portfolio.

Pet System

Animal shop and pet care screen with a cart, six live needs and learned commands played as animations.

Item Manager

Admin panel to list, search, edit and delete database items, with an action log and 10 interface languages.

Death Contract Tablet

Criminal-job tablet with ranks, contract history, a leaderboard and a signed paper contract.

Game Commands Panel

Help panel that builds itself from the commands and keybinds the server sends. Public repo and live demo on GitHub.
